note: F005 legal denylist (ARCHITECTURE.md §13.4, §23.5). Curated by hand, versioned, reviewed at every release, never generated from the book — an automatic refresh would make the gate agree with whatever the writer did. Matching is case-insensitive and stem-based; a multi-word entry matches either part. `persons` and `characters` are errors, `organisations` are warnings, `patterns` are regular expressions matched case-insensitively over prose. The entries are barriers, not vocabulary suggestions and not statements about anyone: a false positive is fixed by editing this file with a recorded reason, never by adding an exception to a prompt. `persons` holds real public figures whose appearance as characters would be a legal problem (реальные лица); `characters` holds protected fictional characters; the list stays short on purpose and is re-reviewed by the owner at M9.
